title: The wagons standing about the 1835 town are photographic too
items: The wagons left standing in the Western Hotel's and Wolf Point's yards and at the roadside on Market, Dearborn and Randolph streets are now the same photographed farm wagon the working teams drive.
With ten teams out on their rounds, fewer wagons stand idle: the other standing farm wagons and covered wagons are gone from the streets. The two covered wagons in the yards stay.
